No. 267 of 1996 on 08.11.2000 and direct the respondents one and two to pay the kitchen allowance to the employees working in the kitchen from 01.04.1993 with interest.
judgment_text:
The Order of the Court was delivered by

S.M. Subramaniam, J.:— The learned counsel for the writ petitioner made a submission that on account of the developments took place during the pendency of the writ petition, the cause aroused for the filing of the present writ petition became vanished. Thus, no further adjudication needs to be entertained in respect of the grounds raised in the present writ petition. The learned counsel for the writ petitioner also seeks the permission of this Court to withdraw the writ petition and he has also made an endorsement to the said effect. Accordingly, the writ petition stands dismissed as withdrawn and disposed of as infructuous. However, there shall be no order as to costs.
